vllm 0.25.0 LlavaOnevision2 processor loader ignores trust_remote_code (RCE). Fix requires vllm>=0.28.0, which hard-pins torch==2.13.0 / torchvision==0.28.0 (verified on PyPI: 0.26.0 pins torch==2.11.0, 0.27.1 and 0.28.0 pin torch==2.13.0); taking it would replace the torch 2.11.0 runtime this DLC's PyTorch 2.11.0 base image contracts for. vllm is present only as the trl online-RL rollout backend; the vulnerable path requires loading an attacker-controlled remote processor class. Bump VLLM_VERSION to 0.28.0 once the HF training image moves onto a torch 2.13 base.
